```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
# Load the package from the checkout with pkgload; no package install is
# required. Under altdoc the render runs in a temp dir, so resolve the root
# first (CFB2NFL_ROOT in the site build, else walk up to the _targets store).
root <- Sys.getenv("CFB2NFL_ROOT", "")
if (!nzchar(root)) {
  dir <- getwd()
  while (!file.exists(file.path(dir, "_targets")) && dirname(dir) != dir) {
    dir <- dirname(dir)
  }
  root <- if (file.exists(file.path(dir, "_targets"))) dir else getwd()
}
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = root)
pkgload::load_all(root, quiet = TRUE)
con <- DBI::dbConnect(
  duckdb::duckdb(),
  file.path(root, "data", "cfb2nfl.duckdb"),
  read_only = TRUE
)
library(DBI)
library(dplyr)
library(duckdb)
library(ggiraph)
library(ggplot2)
library(knitr)
library(tibble)
library(tidyr)

set_girafe_defaults(
  opts_hover = opts_hover(
    css = "stroke:#111827;stroke-width:2.5px;filter:brightness(1.12);"
  ),
  opts_hover_inv = opts_hover_inv(css = "opacity:0.45;"),
  opts_tooltip = opts_tooltip(
    css = "background:#111827;color:#fff;padding:6px 9px;border-radius:5px;font-weight:bold;font-size:15px;"
  ),
  opts_zoom = opts_zoom(min = 1, max = 5),
  opts_toolbar = opts_toolbar(saveaspng = TRUE, position = "topright"),
  opts_sizing = opts_sizing(rescale = TRUE)
)

# Wilson interval for a binomial proportion.
wilson <- function(x, n, z = 1.96) {
  p <- x / n
  d <- 1 + z^2 / n
  c <- (p + z^2 / (2 * n)) / d
  h <- (z / d) * sqrt(p * (1 - p) / n + z^2 / (4 * n^2))
  c(lo = pmax(0, c - h), hi = pmin(1, c + h))
}
fmt <- function(x, digits = 0) {
  formatC(as.numeric(x), big.mark = ",", format = "f", digits = digits)
}
pct <- function(x, digits = 1) sprintf("%.*f%%", digits, 100 * x)

dir_label <- c(
  up = "To a higher tier",
  lateral = "Same tier",
  down = "To a lower tier"
)
dir_colors <- c(
  "To a higher tier" = "#1B9E77",
  "Same tier" = "gray60",
  "To a lower tier" = "#D95F02"
)
# Named tier_name, not tier_label: ps_change already carries a tier_label
# column, and a same-named lookup vector is shadowed by the data mask.
tier_name <- c(`1` = "FCS and below", `2` = "Group of Five", `3` = "Power")
pos_group <- c(
  QB = "Quarterback",
  RB = "Running back",
  FB = "Running back",
  WR = "Receiver",
  TE = "Tight end",
  T = "Offensive line",
  G = "Offensive line",
  C = "Offensive line",
  OL = "Offensive line",
  OT = "Offensive line",
  DL = "Defensive line",
  DE = "Defensive line",
  DT = "Defensive line",
  NT = "Defensive line",
  EDGE = "Defensive line",
  LB = "Linebacker",
  ILB = "Linebacker",
  OLB = "Linebacker",
  DB = "Defensive back",
  S = "Defensive back",
  CB = "Defensive back",
  PK = "Special teams",
  P = "Special teams",
  LS = "Special teams",
  PR = "Special teams"
)
```

```{r}
#| label: load
#| include: false
ps_change <- tbl(con, "ps_change") |> collect()
career <- tbl(con, "career_summary") |> collect()
dbDisconnect(con, shutdown = TRUE)

# A transfer event: an observed season whose team differs from the player's
# prior observed season. Direction compares conference tiers.
tr <- ps_change |>
  filter(transferred) |>
  mutate(
    direction_label = factor(dir_label[transfer_direction], names(dir_colors)),
    from = factor(tier_name[as.character(prev_tier)], tier_name),
    to = factor(tier_name[as.character(tier)], tier_name),
    group = coalesce(unname(pos_group[position]), "Position not recorded")
  )

per_season <- ps_change |>
  group_by(season) |>
  summarise(
    seasons = n(),
    transfers = sum(transferred, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(share = transfers / seasons)
rate <- transfer_rate(career)
ci_career <- wilson(rate$transferred, rate$players)
share_of <- function(y) per_season$share[per_season$season == y]

stopifnot(
  nrow(tr) > 10000,
  # Direction is always assigned once a transfer is observed with both tiers.
  !anyNA(tr$direction_label),
  !anyNA(tr$from),
  !anyNA(tr$to),
  # Pre-rule era stays below five percent; 2026 nears one in five.
  max(per_season$share[per_season$season <= 2020]) < 0.05,
  share_of(2026) > 0.18,
  rate$share > 0.12,
  rate$share < 0.15
)
```

## 1. Introduction

Since the transfer portal opened in 2018 and the one-time transfer waiver
arrived in 2021, changing schools no longer costs a season of play, so this
post measures how often players move and whether the move is to stronger or
weaker competition, with Joe Burrow, Shane Buechele, Jordan Travis, and Cam
Ward as examples.

+ *Expecting transfers to have grown sharply since the 2021 one-time
  transfer rule.*
+ *Expecting most transfers to stay within the same competition tier.*
+ *Expecting players from lower tiers to move up more often than down.*
+ *Expecting quarterbacks and running backs to move down more often than
  other positions.*

## 2. Data

### 2.1 A transfer is a season played at a different school than the player's previous one

The table defines the unit counted, the three competition tiers, and the
three directions a move can take; rosters are thin before about 2016, so
early transfer counts are lower bounds rather than estimates.

```{r}
#| label: terms
tribble(
  ~Term              , ~Meaning                                                                                                                                                           ,
  "Player-season"    , "One player's college season with a recorded stat line."                                                                                                           ,
  "Transfer event"   , "A player-season at a school different from the player's previous observed season; a gap season between the two (such as a redshirt year) does not hide the move." ,
  "Power"            , "Tier 3: the Power conferences, assigned season by season so conference realignment is followed."                                                                  ,
  "Group of Five"    , "Tier 2: the other Football Bowl Subdivision conferences."                                                                                                         ,
  "FCS and below"    , "Tier 1: Football Championship Subdivision and lower divisions."                                                                                                   ,
  "To a higher tier" , "The new school sits in a higher tier than the old one, for example FCS to a Power conference."                                                                    ,
  "Same tier"        , "Both schools sit in the same tier."                                                                                                                               ,
  "To a lower tier"  , "The new school sits in a lower tier, for example a Power conference to the Group of Five."                                                                        ,
  "Share"            , "Transfers divided by player-seasons, with a 95 percent confidence interval: the range the true rate plausibly occupies (computed by Wilson's method)."
) |>
  kable(caption = "The transfer terms used throughout.")
```

## 3. Results

### 3.1 The share of players at a new school rose almost fourfold after the 2020 season

*Expecting transfers to have grown sharply since the 2021 one-time transfer
rule.* ✅

The table and the first figure follow the share of players whose season is
a transfer event, from under five percent through 2020 to
`r pct(share_of(2026))` in 2026; the second figure splits that share by the
tier of the new school.

```{r}
#| label: s31-table
per_season |>
  filter(season %in% c(2016, 2018, 2020, 2021, 2022, 2024, 2026)) |>
  transmute(
    Season = season,
    `Player-seasons` = fmt(seasons),
    `At a new school` = fmt(transfers),
    Share = pct(share)
  ) |>
  kable(
    caption = sprintf(
      "Player-seasons at a new school, selected seasons. Over whole careers, %s of %s players (%s, 95%% CI %s to %s) changed schools at least once.",
      fmt(rate$transferred),
      fmt(rate$players),
      pct(rate$share),
      pct(ci_career["lo"]),
      pct(ci_career["hi"])
    )
  )
```

```{r}
#| label: s31-explain
#| fig-height: 5
trend <- per_season |>

  )
p_trend <- ggplot(trend, aes(season, 100 * share)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 2020.5, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50") +

      "Under 5%% every season\nthrough 2020; %.1f%% in 2026",

  annotate(
    "curve",
    x = 2016.3,
    y = 15,
    xend = 2025.6,
```

### 3.2 Two transfers in five stay in the same tier, and more drop a tier than climb one

*Expecting most transfers to stay within the same competition tier.* ✅

The table and the first figure count the `r fmt(nrow(tr))` transfer events
by direction, with the recurring cast as named examples; the second figure
follows each direction's share season by season.

```{r}
#| label: s32-table
dir_tab <- tr |>
  count(direction_label, name = "n") |>
  mutate(share = n / sum(n))
dir_of <- function(d) dir_tab$share[dir_tab$direction_label == d]
dir_tab |>
  rowwise() |>
  transmute(
    Direction = as.character(direction_label),
    Transfers = fmt(n),
    Share = pct(share),
    `95% CI` = sprintf(
      "%s to %s",
      pct(wilson(n, nrow(tr))["lo"]),
      pct(wilson(n, nrow(tr))["hi"])
    )
  ) |>
  kable(caption = "Transfer events by direction.")

ex <- tr |>
  filter(
    (player == "Joe Burrow" & season == 2018) |
      (player == "Shane Buechele" & season == 2019) |
      (player == "Jordan Travis" & season == 2019) |
      player == "Cameron Ward"
  ) |>
  distinct(player, season, prev_team, team, direction_label) |>
  arrange(player, season)
ex |>
  transmute(
    Player = player,
    Season = season,
    From = prev_team,
    To = team,
    Direction = as.character(direction_label)
  ) |>
  kable(caption = "The recurring cast's transfers.")
```

```{r}
#| label: s32-pin
#| include: false
stopifnot(
  nrow(dir_tab) == 3,
  dir_of("Same tier") == max(dir_tab$share),
  dir_of("To a lower tier") > dir_of("To a higher tier"),
  round(100 * dir_of("Same tier")) == 42,
  nrow(ex) == 5,
  ex$direction_label[ex$player == "Shane Buechele"] == "To a lower tier",
  ex$direction_label[ex$player == "Joe Burrow"] == "Same tier",
  all(
    ex$direction_label[ex$player == "Cameron Ward"] ==
      c("To a higher tier", "Same tier")
  )
)
```


### 3.3 FCS players climb as often as they stay, but Group of Five players drop more than they climb

*Expecting players from lower tiers to move up more often than down.* ❌

The table and the first figure cross each transfer's old tier with its new
one: players leaving FCS and below cannot drop, so they climb or stay,
while Group of Five players drop to FCS more often than they climb to the
Power conferences; the second figure tracks each origin's direction mix by
season.

```{r}
#| label: s33-table
matrix_tab <- tr |>
  count(from, to, name = "n") |>
  group_by(from) |>
  mutate(row_share = n / sum(n)) |>
  ungroup()
cell <- function(f, t, col = "n") {
  matrix_tab[[col]][matrix_tab$from == f & matrix_tab$to == t]
}
matrix_tab |>
  mutate(label = sprintf("%s (%s)", fmt(n), pct(row_share, 0))) |>
  select(From = from, to, label) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = to, values_from = label, values_fill = "0") |>
  kable(
    caption = "Transfer events by old tier (rows) and new tier (columns); the percentage is the share of that row's transfers."
  )
```

```{r}
#| label: s33-pin
#| include: false
stopifnot(
  sum(matrix_tab$n) == nrow(tr),
  cell("FCS and below", "Group of Five") + cell("FCS and below", "Power") >
    cell("FCS and below", "FCS and below"),
  # The failed half of the expectation: Group of Five drops outnumber climbs.
  cell("Group of Five", "FCS and below") > cell("Group of Five", "Power"),
  cell("Power", "Power") == max(matrix_tab$n[matrix_tab$from == "Power"])
)
```

```{r}
#| label: s33-explain
#| fig-height: 5.5
heat <- matrix_tab |>
  mutate(
    direction = case_when(
      as.integer(to) > as.integer(from) ~ "To a higher tier",
      as.integer(to) < as.integer(from) ~ "To a lower tier",
      TRUE ~ "Same tier"
    ),
    from = factor(from, rev(tier_name)),
    to = factor(to, tier_name),
    highlight = from == "Group of Five" & to %in% c("FCS and below", "Power")
  )
p_heat <- ggplot(heat, aes(to, from)) +
  geom_tile_interactive(
    aes(
      fill = direction,
      tooltip = sprintf(
        "%s to %s: %s transfers, %.0f%% of transfers leaving %s",
        from,
        to,
        fmt(n),
        100 * row_share,
        from
      ),
      data_id = paste(from, to)
    ),
    color = "white",
    linewidth = 2,
    alpha = 0.85
  ) +
  geom_tile(
    data = filter(heat, highlight),
    fill = NA,
    color = "#111827",
    linewidth = 1.4
  ) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = sprintf("%.0f%%\n(%s)", 100 * row_share, fmt(n))),
    size = 5,
    fontface = "bold"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = dir_colors) +
  labs(
    title = "Group of Five players drop more often than they climb",
    subtitle = "Share of each old tier's transfers by new tier (rows sum to 100%)",
    x = "New tier",
    y = "Old tier",
    fill = NULL,
    caption = "Outlined: the Group of Five row's two moves, down to FCS and up to the Power conferences."
  ) +
  theme_cfb2nfl() +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank())
girafe(ggobj = p_heat, width_svg = 13, height_svg = 5.5)
```

### 3.4 Quarterbacks and running backs drop a tier more often than any other position

*Expecting quarterbacks and running backs to move down more often than
other positions.* ✅

The table and the first figure rank the position groups by the share of
their transfers that went to a lower tier; the second figure shows each
group's full direction mix.

```{r}
#| label: s34-table
pos_dir <- tr |>
  filter(group != "Position not recorded") |>
  count(group, direction_label, name = "n") |>
  group_by(group) |>
  mutate(share = n / sum(n), transfers = sum(n)) |>
  ungroup()
pos_tab <- pos_dir |>
  select(group, transfers, direction_label, share) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = direction_label, values_from = share) |>
  arrange(desc(`To a lower tier`))
pos_tab |>
  transmute(
    `Position group` = group,
    Transfers = fmt(transfers),
    `To a lower tier` = pct(`To a lower tier`),
    `Same tier` = pct(`Same tier`),
    `To a higher tier` = pct(`To a higher tier`)
  ) |>
  kable(
    caption = sprintf(
      "Transfer direction by position group, ordered by the share moving down. Groups pool roster codes (for example, cornerbacks and safeties are defensive backs); %d transfers with no position recorded are omitted.",
      sum(tr$group == "Position not recorded")
    )
  )
down_of <- function(g) pos_tab$`To a lower tier`[pos_tab$group == g]
```

```{r}
#| label: s34-pin
#| include: false
stopifnot(
  setequal(pos_tab$group[1:2], c("Quarterback", "Running back")),
  round(100 * down_of("Quarterback")) == 41,
  round(100 * down_of("Running back")) == 41,
  pos_tab$group[which.max(pos_tab$`To a higher tier`)] == "Special teams"
)
```

```{r}
#| label: s34-explain
#| fig-height: 6
down_plot <- pos_tab |>
  mutate(
    group = reorder(group, `To a lower tier`),
    highlight = group %in% c("Quarterback", "Running back")
  )
p_down <- ggplot(down_plot, aes(100 * `To a lower tier`, group)) +
  geom_col_interactive(
    aes(
      fill = highlight,
      tooltip = sprintf(
        "%s: %.1f%% of %s transfers moved to a lower tier",
        group,
        100 * `To a lower tier`,
        fmt(transfers)
      ),
      data_id = group
    ),
    width = 0.7
  ) +
  geom_text(
    aes(
      label = sprintf("%.1f%% of %s", 100 * `To a lower tier`, fmt(transfers))
    ),
    hjust = -0.05,
    size = 4.2
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = "#D95F02", `FALSE` = "gray65")) +
  guides(fill = "none") +
  expand_limits(x = 58) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = function(x) sprintf("%.0f%%", x)) +
  labs(
    title = "Quarterbacks and running backs move down most",
    subtitle = "Share of each position group's transfers that went to a lower tier",
    x = "Transfers to a lower tier",
    y = NULL,
    caption = "Offensive line counts only linemen with a stat line, a small and selected group."
  ) +
  theme_cfb2nfl()
girafe(ggobj = p_down, width_svg = 13, height_svg = 6)
```

```{r}
#| label: s34-explore
#| fig-height: 6
mix_plot <- pos_dir |>
  mutate(
    group = factor(group, levels = rev(pos_tab$group)),
    direction_label = factor(direction_label, rev(names(dir_colors)))
  )
p_mix <- ggplot(mix_plot, aes(100 * share, group, fill = direction_label)) +
  geom_col_interactive(
    aes(
      tooltip = sprintf(
        "%s, %s: %.1f%% (%s of %s transfers)",

      ),

    ),
    width = 0.7
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = dir_colors, breaks = names(dir_colors)) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = function(x) sprintf("%.0f%%", x)) +
  labs(
    title = "Every position's full direction mix",
    subtitle = "Share of each position group's transfers by direction",
    x = "Share of the group's transfers",
    y = NULL,
    fill = NULL,
    caption = "Hover a segment for the count."
  ) +
  theme_cfb2nfl()
girafe(ggobj = p_mix, width_svg = 13, height_svg = 6)
```

## 4. Summary

Three of the four expectations hold; the one that fails shows the Group of
Five losing more players downward than it sends up.

```{r}
#| label: summary
tribble(
  ~Expectation                                        , ~Verdict , ~Evidence                                                                                                                                                                                 ,
  "Transfers grew sharply after the 2021 rule"        , "✅"      , sprintf("Under 5%% of player-seasons every season through 2020; %s in 2026.", pct(share_of(2026)))                                                                                        ,
  "Most transfers stay in the same tier"              , "✅"      , sprintf("%s same tier, %s down, %s up.", pct(dir_of("Same tier")), pct(dir_of("To a lower tier")), pct(dir_of("To a higher tier")))                                                       ,
  "Lower-tier players move up more often than down"   , "❌"      , sprintf("Group of Five players dropped to FCS %s times and climbed to the Power conferences %s times.", fmt(cell("Group of Five", "FCS and below")), fmt(cell("Group of Five", "Power"))) ,
  "Quarterbacks and running backs move down the most" , "✅"      , sprintf("%s of quarterback and %s of running back transfers moved down, the two highest.", pct(down_of("Quarterback")), pct(down_of("Running back")))
) |>
  kable(caption = "Each expectation and what the data showed.")
```

## 5. Discussion

::: {.callout-important}
The transfer count is a floor.

- A move is visible only when both seasons carry a stat line, so a player
  who transfers and never records another statistic is not counted.
- Roster coverage is thin before about 2016, so the early rates are lower
  bounds, and part of the rise reflects growing coverage; the climb after
  2020 is steep and sustained, and it lines up with the rule change.
:::

::: {.callout-important}
Direction is measured against competition tiers, not programs.

- A move between two Power programs counts as same tier even when the new
  program is far stronger.
- The `r fmt(sum(ps_change$tier != ps_change$prev_tier & !ps_change$transferred, na.rm = TRUE))`
  player-seasons whose team changed tier through conference realignment,
  without the player changing schools, are not transfers and are excluded.
:::

::: {.callout-important}
Depth charts plausibly explain the position pattern.

- Quarterbacks and running backs at large programs compete in long depth
  charts, and the next available starting job is often one tier down.
- Specialists climb most often: kicking and punting jobs are few, and a
  specialist's route to a Power program often starts at a smaller one.
:::
